scientific_integrity: All-parameter proof by unique cyclic anchors; independent finite cell enumerations for odd orders 5 through 15. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Face-poset Boolean partition is set-theoretic, not a regular subcomplex decomposition or Morse matching; no new homotopy theorem. Unique cyclic regular tournament only. Prior nine-vertex face vector is credited.
title: A Boolean cell stratification and exact face polynomial for cyclic-tournament Hom complexes
